distribution.summary: 黑龙江；辽宁；陕西；四川；云南
distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) confirm mainland records under the historical treatments Hylurgops longipilis and Hylurgops likiangensis, together covering Heilongjiang, Liaoning, Shaanxi, Sichuan and Yunnan. Beaver & Liu (2010) could trace no Taiwanese source for Hylurgops longipilus and retained Taiwan as doubtful. Taiwan is therefore Questionable and excluded from the current distribution summary.

host_note: The current mainland host synthesis is Pinus koraiensis, Pinus armandii, Pinus massoniana, Pinus tabulaeformis and Pinus densata. Source-level spelling Pinus armandi is retained in the historical evidence but normalized in the current synthesis. Beaver & Liu (2010) contributes no Taiwan host evidence.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Hylurgops longipillus (Reitter, 1895).
